newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $103/drsd, passed -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $103/drsd, passed -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids near midday Monday were light at mostly $101.00-$102.00 and a few at $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, but the bids were passed by owners pricing cattle at $104.00-$105.00, sources said.
Owners were asking $65.00 on a live basis, but no bids were reported, they said.
Activity was near a standstill -- typical for a Monday.
Most sales last week were at $103.00, with a few at $104.00 on Tuesday and $102.00 on Friday. Showlists this week were estimated near 82,750 head, down 13,400 from last week.
